invariants.rationale: A returned metadata object should not be null as the method only returns the result of bulkInsert if successful.
The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata parameterized with a List of WriteStatus, and it is expected that getWriteStatuses() returns a non-null List.
The size of the write statuses list is always non-negative.
Each element of the returned list of WriteStatus is expected to be non-null if the bulk insert succeeded.
A successful write should populate partition write stats, which is an internal structure in HoodieWriteMetadata.
